title: Daily agent regression rejects an exit-0 run at a completion or routing evidence gate
symptoms: AWF-REGRESSION-COMPLETE not found although the agent exited 0
Codex routing evidence rejected after successful inference
conditions: The agent exit code is 0 but the host-side evidence gate (completion marker or Codex routing audit) fails
Older code required the marker on its own line without tolerating a preceding terminal control sequence, and required token-usage records that can be absent after successful inference
An old aggregate failure without marker-check.json or codex-routing.json status/diagnostics does not identify the failing gate
rootCause: Success evidence was coupled to terminal output formatting (a cursor-show sequence prefixed the marker line) and to token-usage records. The gates now require an exact standalone LF/CRLF marker line and, for Codex, a persisted api-proxy audit with an HTTP 2xx upstream status or WebSocket 101 handshake.

probe.command: jq -s '{marker: (.[0] | {proof, response, completion}), routing: (.[1] | {status, diagnostics, requests})}' path/to/protected/marker-check.json path/to/protected/codex-routing.json
probe.expect: Read the bounded marker proof/response and completion classifications together with Codex routing status, diagnostics and projected requests. Raw private log bytes are not retained, so historical failures remain unknown.

action: Use source that emits the marker on its own line and collects marker-check.json and the routing audit projection. Fix the classified gate; do not loosen exact marker, proof/response or nonzero-exit checks, and do not accept start/close events as routing success. Hosted acceptance remains separate.
